questions.question: Explain why the matchstick pattern for a row of squares goes 4, 7, 10, 13, and give the rule.
questions.expected_answer: The first square needs 4 matches. Each new square shares a side with the one before, so it adds only 3 matches. The rule is 3 times the number of squares, plus 1.

questions.question: How many beads are in square panel 5 and in panel 10? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: Each panel is a square, so the beads are the panel number times itself. Panel 5 has 5 × 5 = 25 beads and panel 10 has 10 × 10 = 100 beads.

questions.question: Describe the paper-folding pattern and say how many sections there are after 5 folds.
questions.expected_answer: Each fold doubles the number of sections: 2, 4, 8, 16, 32. After 5 folds there are 32 sections.
